text: The plugin id is native-pdf-handwriting, the display name is Handwriting Natively, and the manifest version is 0.1.58.

Sidecar JSON is documented as canonical editable annotation data, recovery is separate, explicit page-structure actions atomically rewrite the open PDF and remap those stores, and Export PDF writes a separate annotated copy.

PDF, image, and Markdown Reading/editing sessions use one draggable floating annotation toolbar with persisted horizontal or vertical orientation and viewport coordinates. A document-level fixed portal avoids view clipping and transforms, and an IntersectionObserver hides it when its owner view is not visible; legacy main/left/right placement settings migrate once and are removed.
Obsidian's global pdf extension mapping stays unchanged for Markdown embeds; direct PDF tabs select PluginPdfView explicitly, and scans migrate native direct leaves while preserving viewer state.
